title: 第9章 把菜市场买空第10章 京城急报
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: “小友你打算出吗？酒樽一般成双成对，你若是有一双，我能出价到五个亿！”
叶苜苜心情沉痛，她不想战承胤年纪轻轻就死了。
五个亿够养活十万人。
可让他两万人打赢三十万蛮族大军，一定不够的！
叶苜苜咬牙，把剩下一只酒樽拿出来。
“我有两只，五个亿出价少了！”
穆老见她真有两只，高兴老花镜框都掉下去了。
他颤抖的手连忙把酒樽拿起，用放大镜看。
他激动嘴皮子直哆嗦，“是，是了，这是一对保存完美，品相极好的一对酒樽！”
“你出价多少？”
叶苜苜说：“我要现钱，出价要顶格。”
穆老眼珠子瞪大，“你要六个亿？”
叶苜苜点头。
他犹豫了！
叶苜苜见状，没有废话，“若是老先生出不起，我可以去隔壁问问！”
她站起身，想要把酒樽收起。
穆老连忙挡住她，“等等，我确实没有这么多现钱，你等半小时，我叫人一起合股买下。”
叶苜苜又坐下。
如果能拿到现金，半个小时等待确实值得。
六个亿不是小数目！
过了一会儿，来了位戴金丝眼镜夹公文包的男人，火急火燎的上楼。
穆老把一只酒樽带楼上去过机器，确定年份去了。
叶苜苜看了眼停在门口某省级博物馆车。
两人在楼上十多分钟就下来了。
戴金丝眼镜的张副馆长，表情亢奋激动的看向叶苜苜，“你还有一只酒樽？”
她把那只酒樽拿出来，放在桌子上。
张副馆长在灯下看，双眼迸发出难以置信的神采。
“太美妙了，两千年的大启国有如此精妙做工，同时期的其他国家，酒樽还是青铜，大启却用黄金，掐丝镂空镶嵌工艺领先其他国家几百年！”
“可惜，这个国家存在时间太短，若是宁关侯战承胤没那么早死，他会带领大启，诛灭其他六国，抵御北方蛮夷，南下收复两广。”
“天妒英才啊！”
叶苜苜握紧包里的酒壶。
战承胤能改变这么多？
如果他没有早死，岂不是会让大统一提前两三百年？
“小姑娘，这酒樽我们要了，六个亿是吗？”
叶苜苜点头。“能付现金吗？”
穆老说：“可以！”
听见手机到账提示音，又查看手机银行后台，
六个亿全部到账。
她准备走时，穆老和张副馆长挽留她，还想聊些什么。
她摇头，“我今天很忙，得走了！”
content_en:
"My friend, are you planning to sell it? Wine bottles usually come in pairs. If you have a pair, I can offer you up to 500 million!"
Ye Miglu was in a sad mood. She didn't want Zhan Chengyin to die at a young age.
Five hundred million is enough to feed 100,000 people.
But it will definitely not be enough for him to defeat an army of 300,000 barbarians with 20,000 people!
Ye Clover gritted his teeth and took out the remaining wine bottle.
"I have two, and the bid of 500 million is less!"
When Mr. Mu saw that she really had two, he was so happy that the frames of his reading glasses fell off.
With trembling hands, he quickly picked up the wine bottle and looked at it with a magnifying glass.
His mouth trembled with excitement, "Yes, yes, these are a pair of wine bottles that are perfectly preserved and in excellent condition!"
"How much do you bid?"
Ye Miglu said: "I want cash, and the price must be the highest."
Old Mu's eyes widened, "You want 600 million?"
Leaf Clover nodded.
He hesitated!
Seeing this, Ye Clover said without any nonsense, "If the old gentleman can't afford it, I can go next door and ask!"
She stood up and wanted to put away the wine bottle.
Mr. Mu quickly blocked her, "Wait a minute, I really don't have that much cash. Just wait for half an hour and I'll ask someone to buy it together."
Clover sat down again.
It's really worth the half hour wait if you can get cash.
Six hundred million is not a small amount!
After a while, a man wearing gold-rimmed glasses and a briefcase came and hurried upstairs.
Mr. Mu took a wine bottle upstairs to the machine to determine the year.
Ye Clover glanced at a provincial museum car parked at the door.
The two of them stayed upstairs for more than ten minutes and then came down.
Deputy Director Zhang, who was wearing gold-rimmed glasses, looked at Ye Miglu with an excited expression, "Do you still have a wine bottle?"
She took out the wine bottle and placed it on the table.
Deputy Curator Zhang looked at it under the lamp, his eyes bursting with incredible expression.
"It's so wonderful. The Daqi Kingdom of two thousand years ago has such exquisite workmanship. In other countries at the same time, wine bottles were still bronze, but Daqi used gold, and the filigree hollow inlay technology was hundreds of years ahead of other countries!"
"Unfortunately, this country has only existed for a short time. If Ningguan Hou Zhan Chengyin had not died so early, he would have led Daqi to annihilate the other six countries, resist the barbarians in the north, and go south to regain Guangdong and Guangxi."
"God is jealous of talents!"
Ye Clover clenched the wine bottle in the bag.
Can Zhan Chengyin change so much?
If he had not died early, wouldn't it have brought about two or three hundred years of unification?
"Little girl, we want this wine bottle, six hundred million, right?"
Leaf Clover nodded. "Can I pay cash?"
Mr. Mu said: "Okay!"
I heard the sound of the account arriving on my mobile phone and checked the backend of mobile banking.
All 600 million have been received.
When she was about to leave, Mr. Mu and Deputy Director Zhang persuaded her to stay and wanted to talk about something else.
She shook her head, "I'm very busy today, I have to go!"
